headline: DET @ HOU matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is DET 4.38 at HOU 4.12, with a projected total of 8.50. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: DET moved +0.44 runs while HOU moved +0.26, changing the projected margin by +0.18 runs. The projected total climbed +0.76, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Yordan Alvarez, Kevin McGonigle, Gleyber Torres, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Christian Vázquez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
